cases.name: charge.zero
cases.about: every field zero, so nothing but the root descriptor

cases.name: charge.benchmark
cases.about: the five-of-ten-fields record the ports benchmark

cases.name: charge.wide values
cases.about: values past the inline nibble, at several widths

cases.name: scalars.zero
cases.about: the omit-zero rule over every scalar kind

cases.name: scalars.extremes
cases.about: every scalar at the end of its range

cases.name: scalars.float trim
cases.about: a float trims its low end, where an integer trims its high one

cases.name: arrays.empty
cases.about: an empty slice is an absent key

cases.name: arrays.mixed
cases.about: every slice kind, signed and unsigned, at several widths

cases.name: arrays.long blob
cases.about: a blob past 2047 bytes, where the size escapes to a wider field

cases.name: arrays.long strings
cases.about: a string array element past 254 bytes, where the length escapes

cases.name: optionals.nil
cases.about: a nil pointer is an absent key and costs nothing

cases.name: optionals.zero
cases.about: a pointer to a zero writes the zero out loud

cases.name: optionals.set
cases.about: a pointer to a value writes it like any other field

cases.name: order.nested
cases.about: a nested key run and a short list of them, row-wise

cases.name: order.table
cases.about: a slice past the threshold, transposed into keyed columns

cases.name: order.empty list
cases.about: an empty slice of structs is an absent key

cases.name: maps.empty
cases.about: an empty map is an absent key

cases.name: maps.one entry each
cases.about: a map's keys are values, not field ids

cases.name: wide.evolved
cases.about: a field id past fifteen, which puts the run on eight-bit keys

cases.name: wide.old peer
cases.about: the same record as a reader that has not heard of the last two fields

cases.name: wide.integer widths
cases.about: every shape a uint16 takes on the wide key, across the varint window

cases.name: hashed.derived ids
cases.about: ids from the hash of the field names, which forces the wide width

cases.name: packed5.string
cases.about: the opt-in string encoding, chosen per field by the descriptor

cases.name: packed5.does not pack
cases.about: a string the packed form would not shrink is written raw
